setting.help: Hands-free interviews: auto-create a draft with the stage's questions when a candidate reaches a call stage, auto-analyze when you paste the Fireflies link, and auto-answer the questions.
setting.div: Paste a Fireflies link once and the client summary + question answers generate themselves. The transcript is still fetched only once per link. Off by default.

setting.help: GDPR data minimization: a daily job clears the stored raw transcript this many days after it was last analyzed. The AI summary and answers are kept; a purged interview is re-fetched from Fireflies only if re-analyzed. Set to 0 to keep transcripts indefinitely.
setting.div: Raw transcripts are personal data. They are cleared this many days after the last analysis (summary and answered questions are kept). 0 = keep indefinitely.
